saturation.label: Throughput Limit Probe
saturation.description: Find the concurrency turning point where throughput stops increasing significantly

sla.label: SLA Maximum Concurrency
sla.description: Find the maximum concurrency that still satisfies latency or throughput constraints

grid.label: Parameter Sweep
grid.description: Measure every combination of concurrency, input length, and output length

agentic.label: Agentic Synthetic Workload
agentic.description: Generate growing multi-turn contexts from a target mean input to measure prefix-cache and concurrency behavior

random.label: Fixed-Length Random
random.description: Generate a new random token or character workload for every request to avoid prefix-cache bias in synthetic data

multiturn.label: OASST1 Multi-turn Conversations (3,826)
multiturn.description: A fixed subset of real upstream conversation trees under Apache-2.0; not production traffic

imported.label: Imported Production JSONL
imported.description: Importing sanitized production samples is recommended for capacity decisions

agenttrace.label: ETO WebShop (removed)
agenttrace.description: Display-only metadata for historical runs; it cannot be selected for a new run
